'''Vincent Edwards''' (born April 5, 1996) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for [[Purdue University]].

==College career==
Edwards committed to [[Purdue Boilermakers men's basketball|Purdue]] from [[Middletown High School (Ohio)|Middletown High School]] in [[Middletown, Ohio]], choosing the Boilermakers over [[Michigan Wolverines men's basketball|Michigan]].<ref>{{cite web| last = Doyle | first = Kevin | title = 2014 forward Vince Edwards commits to Purdue | work = [[NBCSports.com]] | date = September 15, 2013 | url = http://collegebasketball.nbcsports.com/2013/09/15/2014-forward-vince-edwards-commits-to-purdue/| accessdate = August 25, 2017 }}</ref> The versatile [[small forward]] started from his freshman season, earning [[Big Ten Conference]] freshman of the week honors three times.<ref name=clark/> As a sophomore, Edwards averaged 11.3 points and 5.4 rebounds per game and toyed with the NBA draft before deciding to return to Purdue.<ref>{{cite news|last1=Baird|first1=Nathan|title=Purdue's Edwards withdraws from NBA draft|url=http://www.jconline.com/story/sports/college/purdue/basketball/2016/05/24/purdues-edwards-withdraws-nba-draft/84800456/|accessdate=January 16, 2018|work=The Journal & Courier|date=May 24, 2016}}</ref>

In his junior season, he averaged 12.6 points, 4.9 rebounds and 3.6 assists per game and was named third-team All-Big Ten.<ref name=clark>{{cite web| last = Clark | first = Dave | title = Middletown's Vincent Edwards named third-team all-Big Ten | work = [[The Cincinnati Enquirer]] | date = March 7, 2017 | url = http://www.cincinnati.com/story/sports/high-school/ohio-high-school/2017/03/07/middletowns-vincent-edwards-named-third-team-all-big-ten/98846850/| accessdate = August 25, 2017 }}</ref> He scored a career-high 26 points in a 69-64 win over [[Indiana Hoosiers men's basketball|Indiana]] on February 9, 2017.<ref>{{cite news|title=No. 16 Purdue makes late charge to get past Hoosiers 69-64|url=http://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=400914984|accessdate=January 16, 2018|work=[[ESPN]]|agency=[[Associated Press]]|date=February 9, 2017}}</ref> While Edwards was a key player for Purdue during the season, he tended to raise his level of play in the NCAA tournament for the Boilermakers.<ref>{{cite web| last = Osipoff | first = Michael | title = Purdue junior Vincent Edwards shines again on NCAA Tournament stage | work = [[Chicago Tribune]] | date = March 22, 2017 | url = http://www.chicagotribune.com/suburbs/post-tribune/sports/ct-ptb-mens-basketball-purdue-vincent-edwards-st-0323-20170322-story.html| accessdate = August 25, 2017 }}</ref>

Following his junior season, Edwards declared for the [[2017 NBA draft]] without hiring an agent. He ultimately decided to return to Purdue for his senior year.<ref>{{cite web| last = Baird | first = Nathan | title = Purdue's Vincent Edwards returning for senior year | work = [[Journal & Courier]] | date = May 24, 2017 | url = http://www.jconline.com/story/sports/college/purdue/basketball/2017/05/24/purdues-vincent-edwards-returning-senior-year/102090706/| accessdate = August 25, 2017 }}</ref> As a senior, Edwards averaged 14.6 points, 7.4 rebounds and 2.9 assists per game, shooting 47.6 percent from the floor and 39.8 percent from 3-point range. He was a Second Team All-Big Ten selection. He finished his Purdue career with 1,638 points, 779 rebounds and 403 assists and started the second most games for a Boilermaker with 125.<ref>{{cite news|last1=Cassano|first1=Rick|title=College Insider: Purdue’s Edwards wins cash with 3X3U national title|url=https://www.journal-news.com/sports/college-insider-purdue-edwards-wins-cash-with-3x3u-national-title/7T5DVcESwNjek2GcpKt2jJ/|accessdate=April 17, 2018|work=Journal-News|date=April 2, 2018}}</ref>

==International career==
Edwards was a part of the Purdue team chosen to represent the United States in the [[2017 Summer Universiade]] in [[Taipai]], Taiwan.<ref>{{cite web| last = Neubert | first = Brian | title = Vincent Edwards showing signs of alpha potential for Purdue | work = [[Rivals.com]] | date = August 24, 2017 | url = https://purdue.rivals.com/news/vincent-edwards-showing-signs-of-alpha-potential-for-purdue| accessdate = August 25, 2017 }}</ref>

==Personal life==
Edwards is the son of former [[Wright State Raiders men's basketball|Wright State]] star and [[NBA]] player [[Bill Edwards (basketball)|Bill Edwards]].<ref>{{cite web| last = Baird | first = Nathan | title = Purdue's Vince Edwards thankful for mother's lessons | work = [[Indianapolis Star]] | date = November 25, 2015| url = http://www.indystar.com/story/sports/college/purdue/2015/11/25/purdues-vince-edwards-thankful-mothers-lessons/76398956/| accessdate = August 25, 2017 }}</ref>
